4:00 P.M. JURY ROOM, JAMES GREEN PRO TEM. C/C FOR SETTLEMENT CONFERENCE. ALL PARTIES PRESENT. PRESENT FOR MICHAEL C. HALL WAS ATTORNEY JOHN ZANGHI. CASE SETTLED BY CONDITIONAL STIPULATION FOR ENTRY OF JUDGMENT. TERMS RECORDED BY REPORTER DIANA PADILLA ON THE COURT RECORD.
TRIAL OFF CALENDAR

THE COURT ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT HUDSON, WILLIAM PLAINTIFF PATRICK YU TO HAVE STIPULATED JUDGMENT FOR RESTITUTION OF 2790 C MCALLISTER ST. S.F. CA. WITH ATTENDANT GARAGE AND COMMON STORAGE AREAS. IT IS HEREBY ORDERED ADJUDGED AND DECREED: 1. DEFENDANT TO PAY $402.77 ON OR BEFORE 8/1/93 TO THE LAW OFFICES OF MICHAEL C. HALL 345 FRANKLIN ST. ST. CA. 2. DEFENDANT AGREES TO PAY HIS RENT AS IT COMES DUE FOR THE MONTH OF JUNE 1993 AND JULY OF 1993. 3. PLAINTIFF AGREES TO PERFORM FOLLOWING REPAIRS AT THE SUBJECT PREMISE WITHIN SIXTY DAYS: REPAIR HEATER; REPAIR THE STOVE; REPAIR THE WIRING; EXTERMINATE THE FLEAS; REPAIR THE DOOR; REPAIR THE PLASTER ON THE WALLS AND CEILING AND PAINT IF NECESSARY. PLTF. RESERVES THE RIGHT TO PETITION THE RENT ARBITRATION BOARD FOR A RENTAL INCREASE BASED UPON THESE REPAIRS. 4. IF DEFENDANT DEFAULTS, PLAINTIFF UPON 48 HOURS EX PARTE NOTICE TO DEFENDANT IS TO MOVE FOR ENTRY OF JUDGMENT FOR DAMAGES FOR $1,611.00 LESS ANY MONEY RECEIVED AND FOR ATTORNEY FEES AND COST.
